item.title: Bridging Digital and Physical Worlds
item.description: An exploration of the boundary between digital and physical fabrication. From first 3D prints to AI-driven Blender automation, this post examines how state management, deterministic workflows, bidirectional synchronization, and feedback loops shape reliable systems across both software and hardware.
